First release of **runbill**: which GitHub Actions workflow and job is eating your minutes.

- Per-workflow and per-job billed minutes + estimated cost from the runs/jobs API (works now that the `timing` endpoints are closing down)
- Each job rounded up to a whole minute; tariff from runner labels (Linux, Windows, macOS, arm64, `N-cores`, self-hosted)
- Re-run share, `--format text|md|json|csv`, `--fail-over` budget gate (exit 3)
- Composite GitHub Action `Blackman99/runbill@v0.1.0` writing the report to the job summary

Install: `pipx install git+https://github.com/Blackman99/runbill@v0.1.0` · Docs: https://blackman99.github.io/runbill/docs/
